name: Centrosome anchoring and mitotic spindle orientation
rationale: All members concern positioning and anchoring of the centrosome/MTOC and its microtubules; spindle orientation, astral microtubules and asymmetric division distinguish it from centriole-duplication, cytokinesis-ring and centrosome-maturation confusables.

name: Antimicrobial killing of Gram-positive bacteria and fungi
rationale: Members describe host killing and cytolysis of microbes (antifungal humoral response, yeast, Gram-positive defense, metal sequestration), unlike confusables centred on respiratory burst, degranulation or agglutination.

name: CSF1 signaling in macrophage and osteoclast development
rationale: Members cover M-CSF/CSF1 receptor signaling, macrophage proliferation and fusion and osteoclast differentiation driving bone resorption, which separates it from GM-CSF/monocyte-DC confusables and DAP12-centred confusables.

name: Recombination-based telomere maintenance and break-induced replication
rationale: Members concern telomere replication, capping and recombination-based maintenance (D-loops, t-circles, BIR, recombination intermediate resolution), distinguished from confusables by break-induced replication and intra-S checkpoint rather than C-strand synthesis or R-loop/fork reversal.

name: MECP2 transcriptional regulation in neurons and sensory behavior
rationale: Most members describe MECP2 binding, phosphorylation and target-gene regulation with HDAC and neuronal translation control, plus touch/proprioception/visual behaviors affected in Rett syndrome; MECP2 is what the behavior and glycinergic confusables lack.

name: RHOA-subfamily and CDC42 GTPase cycles
rationale: All members are RHO-family small GTPase cycles and effectors; RHOA/B/C, RHOD and formin activation distinguish it from RAC-, IQGAP- and ROCK/PAK/RND-containing confusables.

name: Beta-cell insulin secretion via KATP channels and incretins
rationale: Members describe insulin processing and glucose-stimulated secretion regulated by KATP channels, glucokinase, fatty-acid receptors, GLP-1/GIP and neurotransmitters, whereas confusables centre on insulin receptor signaling and GLUT4 translocation.

name: Glycogen metabolism and intestinal hexose digestion and transport
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis, breakdown and storage diseases together with dietary disaccharide digestion and hexose transporter defects, unlike glycolysis/fructose, urate or galactose confusables.

core: Dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 chemokine production
name: Dendritic cell CCL5 production and cGAS-STING signaling
rationale: Members concern dendritic-cell cytokine and CCL5/chemokine production linked to cGAMP import and STING activation, which separates it from Th1/IL-12, CXCL chemokine, interferon-beta and TLR7/8/9 confusables.

qualifier: BH3-only induction and cytochrome c release
name: p53 transcriptional induction of BH3-only mitochondrial apoptosis
rationale: All members describe p53 transcription of death genes and PUMA/NOXA BH3-only action leading to cytochrome c release, combining the transcriptional arm missing from BAX/BAK confusables with the mitochondrial arm missing from p53-signaling confusables.

name: Cerebellar development and motor coordination behavior
rationale: Members span cerebellar Purkinje/granular layer formation, striatum development, motor learning and locomotion, distinguished from vocal, auditory and glycinergic confusables by cerebellar layers and motor learning.

name: RNA polymerase II transcription regulation, termination and R-loops
rationale: Members concern control of Pol II preinitiation, elongation and termination plus chromatin-level transcriptional control modules; termination and R-loop processing distinguish it from elongation-complex and MYC/rRNA confusables.

name: Telomere maintenance including telomerase RNA Cajal body trafficking
rationale: Members cover telomere replication, telomerase extension, recombination-based maintenance, capping and senescence; Cajal-body localization of telomerase RNA and RNA folding is what the broad DNA-repair confusables lack.

name: Proline and glutamine-family amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are L-amino acid metabolic terms anchored by proline synthesis and catabolism and glutamine-family metabolism, unlike serine/glycine and organic-acid confusables.

name: Heme degradation and hepatic bilirubin conjugation and transport
rationale: Members cover heme/tetrapyrrole catabolism and bilirubin glucuronidation and hepatic uptake/export defects causing hyperbilirubinemia, whereas confusables are drug ADME and xenobiotic transport.

name: Cardiac muscle growth, adaptation and contractility
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, differentiation, hypertrophy and regeneration plus heart rate and contraction force, the latter distinguishing it from the calcineurin-NFAT confusable and all from smooth-muscle confusables.

name: Golgi ribbon organization and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members concern Golgi disassembly, reassembly, ribbon formation and positioning plus membrane tubulation, unlike COPI-traffic and secretory-pathway confusables.

name: COPI and Rab-regulated Golgi traffic and organization
rationale: Members cover COPI retrograde and intra-Golgi transport, vesicle targeting/tethering, Golgi structure and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation, distinguished from TGN-endosome-lysosome and COPII confusables.

core: Imino acid and glycine transporter defects
name: Proline and glycine transporter defects in iminoglycinuria
rationale: All three members are SLC6A20/SLC36A2 transport defects causing iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria, unlike Hartnup, cystinuria and sugar/urate transport confusables.

qualifier: T cell cytotoxicity and MHC class Ib
name: Regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity
rationale: Members regulate NK-cell activation, degranulation and cytotoxicity with T-cell cytotoxicity and MHC class Ib presentation, which the KIR/granzyme and CD8 proliferation confusables lack.

name: Chondrocyte differentiation and cartilage and joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members describe chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy, cartilage condensation and joint morphogenesis, unlike ossification/tendon and articular-cartilage confusables.

name: Base excision repair and alkylation damage reversal
rationale: Members cover glycosylase defects, AP-site processing and long-patch BER plus ALKBH/MGMT direct reversal, distinguishing it from NEIL3/ICL, mismatch-repair and TET demethylation confusables.

name: Urea cycle citrulline synthesis and OTC deficiency
rationale: Members describe the urea cycle and citrulline/arginine synthesis with OTC variants, unlike confusables featuring other urea-cycle enzyme defects or ammonium/ornithine metabolism.

name: COPI vesicle budding and ER-Golgi vesicle targeting
rationale: Members concern COPI budding, Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic and ER-Golgi vesicle targeting, separating it from COPII, tethering and ER protein-targeting confusables.

name: B cell receptor signaling and B cell development
rationale: Members cover BCR signaling (BTK, RAS, CD22, second messengers), its activating and restraining regulation, and B-cell development and proliferation, which the B-cell-identity and T-cell confusables lack.

name: Nucleotide, NAD and phosphocreatine energy-carrier interconversion
rationale: Members concern synthesis, salvage, interconversion and mitochondrial transport of ATP/ADP/GTP and NAD(P), plus creatine phosphate buffering, which separates it from PRPP and apoptosis-linked confusables.

name: Planar cell polarity-driven convergent extension
rationale: All members concern PCP establishment and convergent extension in gastrulation, axis elongation and neural plate morphogenesis, unlike axial mesoderm and ciliary confusables.

name: TLR2/4 and NLRP inflammasome inflammatory cytokine control
rationale: Members regulate TLR2/4 lipopeptide and LPS sensing, NLRP1/3 inflammasome IL-1 processing and pro-inflammatory cytokine output, distinguished from pyroptosis/AIM2 and TRIF/IL-10 confusables.

name: ER membrane protein insertion and COPII export
rationale: Members cover SRP-dependent and tail-anchored targeting and insertion into the ER and COPII cargo loading for ER-to-Golgi export, unlike ER folding/ERAD and COPI confusables.

qualifier: oncogenic mutants and ERK feedback inactivation
name: Oncogenic RAF-ERK signaling and ERK feedback inactivation
rationale: Members describe RAF activation and MAPK signaling by oncogenic RAS/RAF/MAP2K mutants plus ERK dephosphorylation and negative feedback, which the SOS/RIT and RAS-GAP confusables lack.
